content.title: Chuck Hubbard Wins Largest House Majority Since 1992
content.caption: Chuck Hubbard, a Democratic candidate, won the largest majority in the US House of Representatives since 1992, defeating Republican Representative Virginia Foxx in North Carolina.

slides.heading: Chuck Hubbard Wins Largest House Majority Since 1992
slides.text: Chuck Hubbard, a Democratic candidate, won the largest majority in the US House of Representatives since 1992, defeating Republican Representative Virginia Foxx in North Carolina.

slides.heading: Key Details
slides.text: The race was called on Sunday, with Hubbard beating Foxx by 330 votes with 99% counted. It was one of the closest contests of the recent midterm elections, in which Democrats also secured the Senate.

slides.heading: Impact
slides.text: Hubbard pledged to work alongside his fellow lawmakers to hold President Donald Trump accountable. He also prioritised working families and small businesses, supporting public education and expanding access to affordable healthcare.
